argument: If no new opposite branch is selected, the inherited common escape survives. Otherwise choose any selected new branch and its assigned witness. All possible cutters are exactly listed and conflict with that required branch; therefore every selected halfspace is strictly negative at the witness. This applies even after arbitrary optional old-wall deletions.
scope: The finite literal dictionary, with exact algebraic formula branches, admits no finite-volume pairwise Coxeter-compatible selection. The H5 conclusion keeps the four named fixed walls as the face and uses nonpositive pairings with them. It does not exclude other normals, other finite profiles, or other geometric seeds.
